notes.title: Version Adjustment - Third Update Announcement
notes.content:
Hello players,
We have identified an issue in the latest v1.0.3 version where certain monsters remain hidden in Bloody Mode. Our team is urgently working to address this problem. To ensure a smooth experience, the game version will be temporarily rolled back to v1.0.01. Subsequent bug fixes and patches will be bundled into v1.0.04 for release.

Thank you for your understanding and patience.

notes.title: Version 1.0.01 First Update Notice
notes.content:
Thank you for your support, players!
We're curious—how far have you progressed in the game?

Our first update has fixed several early-game bugs, including:
[olist]
Fixed the bug where eyeballs in the Slaughter Room could be destroyed by marbles.

Fixed the issue where room maps weren’t displaying highlights.

Adjusted the reset logic for the floor scale.
[/olist]
If you encounter any other bugs or have suggestions, feel free to join our discord group to discuss!

notes.title: "The final breath" v0.2.14 version update announcement
notes.content:
Thank you for your support of The final breath! The game demo is constantly being optimized!
The contents of this v0.2.14 update are as follows:

(1) Added a story guide at the beginning of the game
(2) Removed the QTE mini-game in stealth
(3) Changed the effect of the tambourine prop to increase stamina by 20%, but increase the lung capacity consumption rate by 20%
(4) Modified the effect of sanity value (San): the spirometry consumption rate is increased by 20% when the san value is below zero.
(5) Backpack compartment expansion
(6) Modified the monster collision mechanism

We will continue to optimize the game, welcome everyone to join the official QQ group: 823261092 continue to give us feedback on any suggestions you have!
